name: [NEW❗] Bike For Egg!
desc:
Welcome to Bike For Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from pets
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!
📖 Complete your Animal Index and claim rewards  

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards and future updates!

scripts.title: Auto farm keyless and more feature
scripts.features:
# Here the features
- Auto Egg (fly up → grab egg → fly up → safezone)
- Select Area (9 areas: AbyssOcean, Cosmic, Desert, Forest, Jungle, Lake, Prehistoric, Snow, Volcano)
- Height Offset (20–200 studs, default 50)
- Teleport StartArea (warp to spawn/safezone)
- Teleport Area (warp to selected area)
- Auto Upgrade Plot (every 1s)
- Upgrade Plot (Once)
- Auto Claim Index (every 2s)
- Claim Index (Once)
- Select Trail (9 trails: GreenTrail, BlueTrail, PurpleTrail, GoldenTrail, RedTrail, GalaxyTrail, SecretTrail, EternalTrail, DivineTrail)
- Purchase Trail
- Auto Upgrade Trail (every 1s)
- Upgrade Trail (Once)
- Equip Best (every 2s)
- Auto Hatch (placeholder)
- Select Bike (6 bikes: BrazilBike, SpaceBike, FrostBike, RighteousBike1, Korblox, FrozenFlame)
- Buy Selected Bike
- Quick Buy Bike (6 individual buttons)
- Theme Switcher (10 themes: NeverloseCrimson, StarHubGold, CyberCyan, MatrixEmerald, ObsidianViolet, SakuraBlossom, GlacierIce, SunsetFlame, ElectricLime, MidnightStealth)
- Background Effect (7 modes: Off, Ambient Glow, Floating Bubbles, Matrix Cyber Rain, Starlight Fireflies, Fire Embers, Snowfall Drift)
- Controls Position (Left / Right)
- Toggle Key (default: RightControl)
- Sound On/Off + Volume
- Floating Toggle Show/Hide
- AutoSave Config
